title: ERalpha anthraquinone molecular dynamics inputs and analysis data V11
description: Simulation inputs and derived analyses supporting Molecular dynamics guides anthraquinone drug design by resolving estrogen receptor alpha recognition geometry, manuscript V11. The V11 supplement supplies 11022 frame-level geometric measurements, reconstruction and verification scripts for the instantaneous bridging bound, equation-derived ensemble analyses, fingerprint-score checks, and the updated Figure 1 data and plotting source. The unchanged V9 release provides the simulation-input archives for 34 retained conventional runs, 45 umbrella windows (708 ns nominal) and 12 shared-bias AWH walkers (87.504 ns). Coordinate trajectories and proprietary software are excluded. Derived-data checks run without trajectories; rebuilding those measurements from original coordinates requires the saved trajectories. Local prediction files retain their original project timestamps; no external registration is claimed.
notes: The data license applies to the authors' new numerical data and records. Third-party force-field material, existing software and adapted code retain their original terms as detailed in LICENSE_SCOPE.md. This metadata file does not claim that a Zenodo record or DOI already exists.
